clips.title: The story
paras: The Dawning Isles lie blighted beneath the Vile Fin murlocs’ growing numbers. Along Silverpine Forest’s eastern edge, the islets rise from Lordamere Lake, where the Plague of Undeath has left their shores rotting.

The Dawning Isles lie under the Vile Fin murlocs’ claim. Before the Third War, these keys rested amid Lordamere Lake’s calm, clear waters. When the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron, corruption spread through the shallows. The vegetation turned pallid and rotting, and the islands lost their former peace. Now the Vile Fin murlocs hold the muddy shores and tangled brush. They defend their growing colonies against anyone who tries to cross the lake.

Bog beasts once prowled the blighted Dawning Isles alongside the murlocs. The bog beasts have since vanished, leaving the Vile Fin population to swell. The murlocs now control the isles outright, making the chain of keys their stronghold on Lordamere Lake.
